'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2019–2021 Iraqi protests]]
**One protester is killed and dozens are injured after police attack protesters gathered at [[Baghdad]]'s [[Tahrir Square, Baghdad|Tahrir Square]] in the evening, where hundreds marched to demand the end of targeted killings of prominent journalists and activists. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/05/25/iraq-protests-one-killed-amid-clashes-between-demonstrators-and-security-forces (Euronews)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
**[[Tata Steel]] has said that it will support the families of its workers in India who have died of [[COVID-19]]. The firm said that it will pay deceased employees' salaries, housing and medical benefits until what would have been their retirement at the age of 60. The company has also pledged to cover the education costs of the children of deceased front line workers until they graduate. This is the third firm to make such an announcement, after hospitality group [[Oyo Rooms]] and glass manufacturer [[Borosil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-57236708 (BBC News)]
*[[Costa Rica]] becomes the 38th member of the [[Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/costa-rica-becomes-latest-member-of-oecd-01621963213?tesla=y (Barron's)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Motor Vessel|MV]] ''[[X-Press Pearl]]'', a container ship sailing with a [[Singaporean]] flag and carrying cosmetics and chemicals, including 25 tonnes of [[nitric acid]], catches fire off the coast of [[Sri Lanka]] after an explosion was detected onboard. Rescuers evacuated all crew from the ship and reported that two people were injured. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lanka-evacuates-crew-burning-container-ship-2021-05-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 7,289 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 525,889. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/malaysia-reports-record-7289-coronavirus-cases-highest-daily-count (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] surpasses 20,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/05/25/21/philippines-covid19-cases-update-may252021 (ABS-CBN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 447 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, prompting the [[Government of Vietnam|government]] to expand the [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] measures in [[Bac Ninh]], such as imposing curfew and travel restrictions. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-vietnam/vietnam-reports-daily-record-447-covid-19-cases-idUSL3N2NC3GJ (Reuters)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/covid-19-vietnam-expands-lockdown-measures-infections-record-14882974 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] announces that 50% of the American adult population has been fully vaccinated. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/half-us-adults-fully-vaccinated-n1268424 (NBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Moderna]] says that [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|their vaccine]] is 100% effective in teenagers between the ages of 12 and 17. They say that they will seek approval from the U.S. [[Food and Drug Administration]] in early June. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/25/covid-vaccine-moderna-says-shot-is-100percent-effective-in-teens-plans-to-seek-fda-ok-in-june.html (CNBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***Restrictions are tightened in [[Melbourne]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]], after an increase in cases, potentially linked to a hotel quarantine breach in [[South Australia]]. The mask mandate is reintroduced, public gatherings are limited to 30 people and private gatherings are limited to 5 people. Residents will also be expected to adhere to these rules when leaving the city. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/may/25/covid-victoria-restrictions-melbourne-coronavirus-rules-covid19-explained-masks-compulsory-exercising-gatherings-what-you-need-to-know (''The Guardian'')]

*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**Four people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] at an apartment complex in [[West Jefferson, Ohio]]. The killings mark the village's first homicides in nine years. [https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/2021/05/25/west-jefferson-shock-after-shooting-leaves-least-3-dead/7430200002/ (''The Columbus Dispatch'')]
*[[New York County District Attorney|Manhattan District Attorney]] [[Cyrus Vance Jr.]] says that he has convened a grand jury in his criminal investigation into former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] over his [[Business career of Donald Trump|real estate business]], as well as the [[The Trump Organization|Trump Organization]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/05/25/manhattan-da-convenes-grand-jury-in-trump-investigation-report-says.html (CNBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2018–2021 Arab protests]]
**On the third day of economic protests, [[Oman]]i protestors conduct [[sit-in]]s at a bridge in [[Sohar]], and similar protests occur in [[Rustaq]], [[Nizwa]], and [[Sur, Oman|Sur]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/25/protest-in-oman-over-poor-economy-jobs-continue-for-third-day (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamophobia in the United Kingdom]] 
**An independent report commissioned by the ruling [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] on discrimination within the party details that two-thirds of the 727 discrimination complaints filed against the party from 2015 to 2020 are classified as Islamophobic incidents. Incidents listed include comments made by [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] about [[Islamic clothing|the attire]] of Muslim women, and comments by [[Mayor of London|London Mayoral]] candidate [[Zac Goldsmith]] about his opponent and current Mayor [[Sadiq Khan]] during the [[2016 London mayoral election|2016 election]]. It also found "no evidence" that these complaints were treated significantly different from other complaints. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/25/uk-conservative-party-has-ongoing-issue-with-islamophobia-report (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[United States Department of Agriculture]] (USDA) announces that it will begin making $4 billion of loan forgiveness payments for 13,000 loans that were made by the agency to Black, Hispanic and Indigenous farmers beginning in June. From there, the agency said that it will also distribute loan relief for another 3,000 loans which were made by banks and guaranteed by the USDA. The program has been delayed because of accusations of racism and is currently facing multiple lawsuits. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy/usda-debt-forgiveness-black-farmers-june (FOX Business)]
